notes.title: Updated to Version 3
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've updated the game to version 3.
The changes are:
[olist]
Added COIN ATTACK mode, where score only shows the coins you got that run!

Fixed some issues with coins

Improved physics system to get better performance on real hardware

Improved the skin change logic
[/olist]
Thank you!
